articles.title: The next hurdle for AI agents: getting websites to let them in
articles.description: Personal AI agents promise to shop, book flights, and make reservations for you. But deliberate blocks and anti-bot defenses are getting in the way, leaving consumers caught in the middle. A new standard aims to help.

articles.title: Instinct brings its AI agent to group chats, even for friends without an account
articles.description: Instinct is launching group chats that let friends use its AI agent together for tasks like planning trips, organizing carpools, and coordinating events. The company says personal accounts remain separate, with permission required before personal agents share information or take action.

articles.title: TikTok rolls out an AI shopping assistant and one-click checkout
articles.description: TikTok describes its new Shopping Assistant as a conversational AI agent designed to help users discover and purchase products.

articles.title: How Jump Trading is scaling quant research with ChatGPT
articles.description: Jump Trading uses OpenAI to expand quantitative research. See how longer-running AI workflows combine multiple data sources with human review.

articles.title: Sharing AI progress in mathematics
articles.description: OpenAI publishes new results on open problems in mathematics from an internal frontier model and shares Lean proof formalizations and research details on GitHub.

articles.title: Advancing computer use with Ironclad
articles.description: Learn how OpenAI and Ironclad are training and evaluating AI agents on complex contracting workflows to advance computer use for professional work.

articles.title: Atlassian and OpenAI expand partnership to turn enterprise knowledge into action
articles.description: Atlassian and OpenAI are expanding their partnership to connect frontier models with enterprise knowledge and help teams plan, build, and deliver work.

articles.title: Our approach to EU text provenance rules
articles.description: How OpenAI is approaching text watermarking under EU rules. Learn where watermarks apply, how detection works, and why access starts with researchers.

articles.title: Building advertising for the way people use AI
articles.description: OpenAI introduces a new visual ad format in ChatGPT and expands measurement tools, attribution partnerships, and brand suitability for advertisers.

articles.title: A model guide for the GPT-6 family
articles.description: Learn how startups can choose GPT-6 models, tune reasoning effort, improve prompts and skills, coordinate tools, and prepare workflows for production.
